_comment: Every base image the harness builds on, pinned by digest (TICKET-038).
A tag moves; a digest does not, and a test suite that quietly changes
its server between two runs cannot tell you what regressed.
To refresh one: docker pull <tag> && docker image inspect <tag>
_debian_why: The FTP services do not use Alpine: vsftpd 3.0.5 on musl segfaults as
soon as a TLS session is established, taking the whole server down.
Reproduced on Alpine arm64 with nothing but a login. Debian's build
serves the same three TLS modes without dying.
